' > /mnt/server/www/index.html ln -sfn /mnt/server/www /mnt/server/public else if [[ ${WEBSITE_REPO} != *.git ]]; then WEBSITE_REPO="${WEBSITE_REPO}.git" fi if [ -n "${WEBSITE_TOKEN}" ]; then GIT_DOMAIN=$(echo "${WEBSITE_REPO}" | sed -E 's|https://([^/]+)/.*|\1|') GIT_REPO_PATH=$(echo "${WEBSITE_REPO}" | sed -E 's|https://[^/]+/(.*)|\1|') AUTH_USER="${WEBSITE_USERNAME:-x-access-token}" CLONE_URL="https://${AUTH_USER}:${WEBSITE_TOKEN}@${GIT_DOMAIN}/${GIT_REPO_PATH}" echo "[Website] Using authenticated Git access." else CLONE_URL="${WEBSITE_REPO}" echo "[Website] Using anonymous Git access." fi rm -rf /mnt/server/www mkdir -p /mnt/server/www if [ -n "${WEBSITE_BRANCH}" ]; then git clone --branch "${WEBSITE_BRANCH}" --single-branch "${CLONE_URL}" /mnt/server/www > /dev/null 2>&1 \ && echo "[Website] Repository cloned successfully (branch '${WEBSITE_BRANCH}')." \ || { echo "[Website] Error: git clone failed (branch '${WEBSITE_BRANCH}')."; exit 14; } else git clone "${CLONE_URL}" /mnt/server/www > /dev/null 2>&1 \ && echo "[Website] Repository cloned successfully." \ || { echo "[Website] Error: git clone failed."; exit 14; } fi fi echo -e "[DONE] Everything has been installed successfully" echo -e "[INFO] You can now start the Next.js server"

variables.name: Enable Auto-Update
variables.description: Check for egg infrastructure updates on startup

variables.name: Force Auto-Update
variables.description: Automatically apply egg updates without confirmation

variables.name: Next.js Version
variables.description: Target Next.js version for your project (default 16). Ensure next is in your package.json.

variables.name: Node.js Version
variables.description: Node.js version matching your Docker image. Use 22 for Next.js 16.

variables.name: Site Port
variables.description: Port your site listens on. Set to your Pterodactyl allocation port.

variables.name: Website Repository
variables.description: Git URL of your Next.js project

variables.name: Website Branch
variables.description: Branch to deploy from your Next.js repo

variables.name: Website Access Token
variables.description: Personal Access Token for private repos. Leave blank for public repos.

variables.name: Website Git Username
variables.description: Git username for private repo auth. Default: x-access-token

variables.name: Enable Website Deploy
variables.description: Pull Next.js repo updates on every restart. 0 = false, 1 = true

variables.name: Enable Next.js Build and Start
variables.description: Install deps, next build, and next start on restart. 0 = false, 1 = true

variables.name: Install Command
variables.description: Command to install dependencies before build

variables.name: Build Command
variables.description: Next.js production build command

variables.name: Start Command
variables.description: Next.js production start command. Set to none for static export only.

variables.name: Serve Mode
variables.description: node = Nginx proxies to Next.js. static = serve static export only.

variables.name: Static Export Directory
variables.description: Output folder for static export mode only (default: out)

variables.name: Enable LogCleaner Module
variables.description: Run log cleanup on container startup

variables.name: Enable Cloudflare Tunnel
variables.description: Start Cloudflared tunnel on startup

variables.name: Cloudflared Tunnel Token
variables.description: Cloudflare Tunnel token

variables.name: Enable Cron Module
variables.description: Enable cron job scheduling

variables.name: Cron Config File
variables.description: Path to crontab configuration file

variables.name: Enable Certbot SSL
variables.description: Enable Certbot SSL certificate management. 0 = false, 1 = true

variables.name: Certbot Email
variables.description: Email for Let's Encrypt notifications

variables.name: Certbot Domain
variables.description: Primary domain for SSL certificate

variables.name: Certbot Webroot Path
variables.description: Document root for webroot validation

variables.name: Certbot Staging Mode
variables.description: Use Let's Encrypt staging server. 0 = Production, 1 = Staging

variables.name: Certbot Force Renewal
variables.description: Force certificate renewal. 0 = renew when needed, 1 = force
